same_obligations: same admitted execute/skip family and lifecycle obligations

current_methods.name: Share checks across a branch family
current_methods.claim: Projection + admission + endpoint-supported ordering checks the same finite execute/skip family without rerunning every choice.
current_methods.result: N1: 56.98 s enumeration vs 50.53 s family (1.13x), with 0.81 vs 4.07 GiB peak RSS. N2 family completes; enumeration reaches the limit.
current_methods.boundary: Only N1 has a matched speedup. N3 reaches the limit; arbitrary loop length is not solved.

current_methods.name: Use guarded conflict-order candidates
current_methods.claim: When duplicate-store exemptions provably cannot apply, check sparse conflict-order obligations instead of the default larger set.
current_methods.result: Constructed N112 source artifact: 2,216,264 -> 96,128 queries; native analysis 308.23 -> 232.18 ms.
current_methods.boundary: Three real-corpus trials showed fallback or resource limits, not a real-corpus speedup.

current_methods.name: Batch reachability by source
current_methods.claim: The existing bitset backend shares propagation for queries with the same source inside one batch.
current_methods.result: N112 strict probe: 6.53 ms DFS vs 4.00 ms bitset HB time; whole instrumented runtime ranges overlap.
current_methods.boundary: This is an existing backend, not our new contribution or an end-to-end speedup.

historical_methods.name: Exact-epoch local proof domain
historical_methods.idea: Prove only one justified generation interval, retaining contributor identity and counters.
historical_methods.decision: Keep the invariant; do not build a second Q/P simulator because Wasp already performs generation analysis.

historical_methods.name: Strict ranks + bad-prefix cut
historical_methods.idea: Represent a finite schedule by ranks and ask whether a bad prefix exists.
historical_methods.decision: Useful as a mathematical encoding, but no native backend or arbitrary-N result exists.

historical_methods.name: Shared HB expressions at waits
historical_methods.idea: Reuse symbolic reachability expressions across queries that cross the same wait interface.
historical_methods.decision: Coupled to the old rank/matching model; it is not the current bitset implementation.

historical_methods.name: Certified generation partition
historical_methods.idea: Fix justified generation releases first, reducing symbolic wait-match alternatives.
historical_methods.decision: Formula construction shrank, but both large solver runs returned unknown. Current family projection is a different rule.

historical_methods.name: Observation factorization
historical_methods.idea: Group access-pair observations into rectangles while preserving the exact published query set.
historical_methods.decision: The preservation contract remains useful; guarded conflict-order preserves race existence, not identical query lists.

historical_methods.name: Targeted concrete reachability
historical_methods.idea: Answer only requested HB pairs and share traversal work instead of rebuilding each pair independently.
historical_methods.decision: Batched bitsets already do the main sharing. Only 55 pairs repeat across batches at N112, so no extra exact-pair cache was added.

historical_methods.name: Frontier / decomposition / POR
historical_methods.idea: Split repeated work into independent frontiers or quotient equivalent interleavings.
historical_methods.decision: Shared effects defeat the proposed decomposition; no successful generic POR migration is claimed.

historical_methods.name: Exact-epoch finite DAG proof
historical_methods.idea: Under explicit finite premises, prove every original obligation on the reduced DAG.
historical_methods.decision: Reuse the proof discipline, not its runtime or a whole-source safety verdict.

notes: N1: both complete; family has modest end-to-end advantage but higher memory.
N2: family completes while enumeration reaches the 120 s limit; no speedup is reported.
N3: family reaches the limit; larger sizes are stopped by contract.
partial-address prototype has no demonstrated real-input gain.
two-output cohort is incomplete and parent telemetry is missing.
